name: Extract .doc and .docx files with Sensible
post-body:
With new format support for Microsoft Word, you can now use Sensible to extract .doc and .docx files. Send your .doc or .docx file to any Sensible endpoint or upload directly to the Sensible app as usual.

Enhanced support for new document formats broadens potential use cases, giving you new ways to make use of Sensible’s extraction capabilities. Have specific formats in mind? Let us know at hello@sensible.so. 

Try the new Microsoft Word format support out today – just send your document to Sensible as usual for extraction.
